attributes.context: This clause appears in Article II of an electrical industry collective bargaining agreement alongside provisions on non-discrimination, special job terms, grievance deadlines, foreman referral, and applicant referral.

extraction_text: Article II, Section 8 - There shall be no restrictions against the use of any machinery, equipment, tools or other devices when used by electrical employees covered by this Agreement who are properly trained, and/or certified if required, and in accordance with the applicable safety orders.
